summary: Master RPA implementation and governance. Learn to build bots, design PDDs, and lead a Center of Excellence. Enroll now for expert-led RPA training.
lede: RPA Orchestrator training covers managing bot schedules, queues and assets, as well as monitoring bot health and utilization. It is designed for automation developers, business analysts and IT operations managers who work with digital workflows. Learners practise testing and deploying bots, handling workflow exceptions, and tracking performance through dashboards.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level course is tailored for professionals who have a foundational understanding of business processes and wish to lead or execute technical automation initiatives within their organizations.
audience: Process Improvement Specialists focused on Lean
modules: Enterprise RPA Architecture and Tool Selection
Development Best Practices and Exception Handling
RPA Governance and Center of Excellence
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 2 years of experience in business process management, IT operations, or systems analysis. Familiarity with basic programming logic (if/then statements, loops) is required, though advanced coding skills are not necessary. Access to a laptop with administrative rights for software installation is essential for the hands-on labs.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
